title: Investigation by the Department on its own motion as to the propriety o the rates and charges set forth in in the following tariff: M.D.P.U. No 14, filed with the Department on November 23, 1990 to become effective December 22, 1990 by Gay Head Sightseeing Co., Inc.
filings: Letter from Robert G. Parks, unsigned. Gay Head Sightseeing has determined that it is not in the best interests of carriers, and withdraws the tariff (90-318).
